items.title: Freeze confirmation and baseline capture
items.test: Artifacts record main SHA, current branch, tenant registry, static SQL inventory, route baseline, and runtime blocker.

items.title: Live database catalog and row profile
items.dependency: network path to Azure Postgres private endpoint
items.test: Read-only catalog, row counts, last update timestamps, and pg_stat evidence captured with application_name.

items.title: Runtime query writer/reader instrumentation plan
items.test: Each request/job emits tenant, route/job, correlation id, table/view, read/write, rows, timestamp, flag, and consumer.

items.title: Tenant identity contract approval
items.test: Registry, app aliases, admin aliases, enterprise-context schema, and inventory substrate mappings reconcile to one approved contract.
items.rollback: Keep existing alias mappers; no migration.

items.title: Application/system authority selection
items.dependency: tenant identity contract and live row profile
items.test: Application IDs reconcile across active inputs, generated files, Tower projections, Home snapshots, and enterprise context.

items.title: Data asset/integration authority selection
items.test: Business keys, source lineage, and tenant scoping are defined for each object.

items.title: Evidence/document canonical registry contract
items.test: Uploaded file, parsed chunks, evidence ledger, extraction rows, and artifact citations share evidence IDs and hashes.
items.rollback: Keep existing upload and retrieval paths.

items.title: Relationship authority and graph quality report
items.test: Relationship type dictionary, evidence-backed graph edges, and quality report exist before graph consumers switch.

items.title: Metric definition and observation authority
items.dependency: Tower live profile and duplicate metric report
items.test: Definitions are registry-owned; observations are governed, tenant-scoped, source-cited, and not calculated by graph consumers.
items.rollback: Keep existing Tower mart and fallback reads.

items.title: Use case/program publication outbox
items.test: Approved program identity/facts publish to canonical Knowledge without moving workflow state prematurely.
items.rollback: Disable outbox consumer; keep engagements read path.

items.title: Consumer dual-run for one pilot route
items.dependency: canonical object families and projections built in shadow
items.test: Legacy and new reads compare equal-or-better under signed-in route proof and query telemetry.
items.rollback: Feature flag back to legacy read path.

items.title: Artifact authority separation
items.dependency: evidence registry and approved fact publication
items.test: Generated artifacts are immutable projections; accepted authoritative artifacts cite reviewed facts and source hashes.
items.rollback: Keep generated/draft artifacts from becoming client-final.
